title: OpsTruss backend.json
description: The plugin backend that this checkout last kept the state of a scope in, in .opstruss/state/<scope>/backend.json: its source with the pin, its with and pass as written, and the location it gave. No file means the local backend. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

uses.description: The source of the plugin, as the backend names it.

commit.description: The commit that opstruss.lock pins the source to.

hash.description: The hash of the source at that commit, as opstruss.lock keeps it.

with.description: The inputs of the plugin as written, with their expressions.

location.description: Where the plugin keeps the state, as it answered initialize.
